subject.title: [Feature] Allow configuring Gemini safety settings in OpenClaw

question: Should OpenClaw expose a first-class Gemini safety-settings config knob, and what exact schema, category set, thresholds, Google-only scope, and request-precedence rules should it support?
rationale: This adds a new safety-affecting provider config surface that can change upstream content blocking, so automation should not choose the public contract or safety posture without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve narrow Google setting
options.body: Add a strict Google-scoped models.providers.*.safetySettings or equivalent contract with documented categories, thresholds, request precedence, and tests.

options.title: Keep provider defaults only
options.body: Decline the config surface for now and leave Gemini safety behavior on upstream defaults to avoid adding a safety-affecting knob.

options.title: Design broader provider settings seam
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define a general provider-specific request-settings API for Google and future provider-owned controls.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow Google setting
recommendation.body: Add a strict Google-scoped models.providers.*.safetySettings or equivalent contract with documented categories, thresholds, request precedence, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest current routing signal from prior issue discussion plus recent Google provider/docs history.
